**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/03/19 (Sun) 16:29  
[EVENT] User is thinking of scheduling a maintenance check for their road bike at the local bike shop.  
[EVENT] User decided to upgrade their road bike's pedals to clipless pedals today.  
[PREFERENCE] User is considering upgrading to Shimano Ultegra pedals.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on their decision to upgrade to clipless pedals.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a step-by-step guide for installing Shimano Ultegra pedals, including tools needed and pre-installation checks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant listed tools needed: Shimano Ultegra pedals, pedal wrench, and optional grease.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant outlined pre-installation checks: check pedal compatibility and prepare shoes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant detailed the installation process, including removing old pedals, inspecting and cleaning the crankset, applying grease, installing new pedals, tightening pedals, and checking them.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided steps for setting up shoes and pedals, including attaching cleats, adjusting cleat position, and practicing clipping in and out.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended a final check of the pedals and a test ride after installation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised considering professional assistance if the user is uncomfortable with the installation process.  
[PREFERENCE] User is concerned about the brakes on their road bike feeling spongy.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained possible causes of spongy brakes, including air in the system, worn or damaged brake pads, contaminated brake pads, misaligned brake caliper, and cable stretch or wear.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested potential solutions, including adjusting the brakes, replacing brake pads, replacing brake cables, or replacing the brake caliper or lever.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended having the mechanic inspect the brake system during the maintenance check to determine the root cause of the spongy feel.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised the user to communicate their concerns and symptoms to the mechanic for a detailed assessment.  
[PREFERENCE] User wants to ask the mechanic to check the brake pads for wear and contamination during the maintenance check.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant confirmed that it's a good idea to have the mechanic inspect the brake pads and provided steps to ask the mechanic to inspect and provide an estimate for replacement if needed.  
[PREFERENCE] User is noticing skipping and hesitation when shifting gears.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested asking the mechanic to inspect the chain and gears for wear and provide an estimate for replacing the chain if it's worn out.
